purpose: Prevent malformed TRACE/SOLID geometry and silent 3DFACE field loss in DWG output.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: 3DFACE stores its four WCS corners and invisible-edge flags; SOLID and TRACE store thickness, shared elevation, four OCS corner XY pairs and extrusion.
authority.readerConsistency: The corresponding DWG parsers reject non-finite decoded values before publishing a typed entity.

implementation.behavior: TRACE/SOLID writer preflight now checks all modeled coordinates, thickness and extrusion for finiteness while retaining the existing shared-elevation rule. 3DFACE preflight checks all corners and edge-flag range, and refuses nonzero thickness or nondefault extrusion fields absent from its DWG body.
implementation.scope: Writer admission only; readers and tolerated malformed source handling are unchanged.

generatedControls.failureRetry: Every refusal preserves the seeded destination. Corrected same-writer output reads back typed corner geometry with zero entity/object parse failures.
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: All test files are authored from scratch in scratch storage; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: The generated control establishes bounded writer field admission and retry/readback only, not native surface semantics or producer prevalence.
The broader P6 geometry/no-loss and consumer gates remain open.
supportClaimEffect: Closes bounded DWG TRACE/SOLID finite-field and 3DFACE omitted-field writer gaps; no broad support claim is promoted.
